name: ProviderStuff
overview: Applies provider tags, manages provider collections, and exposes provider/item APIs with pagination.
description: ProviderStuff automates tagging items with provider:<name> tags, maintains optional Box Set collections, and provides API endpoints to list providers and items.
changelog: - Jellyfin 10.11+ compatibility; config page button styling

versions.changelog: - Fix: config page button colors on Jellyfin dark theme

- Fix: Jellyfin 10.11+ MissingMethodException for ILibraryManager.GetItemList
- Fix: collection logo download via SaveImage on Jellyfin 10.11+
